versions.subject: Created Win Regedit import rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\regedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /i '
        - '.reg'
selection_2:
    CommandLine|re: ':[^ \\]'
filter:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /e '
        - ' /a '
        - ' /c '
condition: selection and selection_2 and not filter
versions.spl: Image="*\\regedit.exe" CommandLine IN ("* /i *", "*.reg*") NOT (CommandLine IN ("* /e *", "* /a *", "* /c *")) | regex CommandLine=":[^ \\\\]"
